plainLanguage: Section 141 — House holder, etc., permitting defilement of girl on his premises. Ufafanuzi huu unafuata masharti ya statutory text bila kubadilisha maandishi rasmi.
meaning: Section 141 must be analysed from its exact conduct, age, consent, knowledge, intention, premises and penalty requirements where applicable.
keyPoints: Apply each paragraph and proviso exactly as written.
Age, consent, knowledge, intention and premises-related requirements must be proved where stated.
Preserve any statutory defence, compensation requirement and penalty.

history.summary: Section 141 appears in Chapter XV — Offences Against Morality — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Verified against the official R.E. 2022 government publication.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Liability should follow the express statutory ingredients rather than assumptions based on the heading.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Age thresholds, consent, knowledge, intention and express defences require separate proof and analysis where applicable.

debateQuestion: Je, facts na evidence zinatimiza masharti yote ya section 141?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
